# GridPulse

GridPulse is an evidence-led grid connection decision-support platform for BESS, data-centre and large-load projects in Germany.

## Public pages

- Home: https://gridpulseinsights.com/
- Interactive demonstration: https://gridpulseinsights.com/demo
- Design-partner pilot application: https://gridpulseinsights.com/pilot

GridPulse structures project requirements and connection evidence, compares unrestricted and flexible connection options, and quantifies operational constraints. It does not infer available grid capacity, and network-operator evidence remains controlling.
